questions.stem: A 48-year-old man with a previous history of deep vein thrombosis presents to the medical department with complaints of dizziness, abdominal pain, anorexia, palpitations, and shortness of breath on exertion. He has pallor, his temperature is 37°C (98.6°F), his pulse is 105/min, his respiration rate is 28/min, and his blood pressure is 90/70 mm Hg. He has mild abdominal distention and swelling in his legs. Upon duplex ultrasonography, a diagnosis of inferior vena cava (IVC) obstruction has been made. Which of the following veins is a tributary of the IVC?
